models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri between Instrument Cluster (J285) and Climatronic Control (J255) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri between Instrument Cluster (J285) and Climatronic Control (J255)
technicalNotes: If this fault won't clear with key on, engine off, try clearing it while the engine is running.
